chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ibn Miskān, from Ibn Zurārah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, and from Abū Baṣīr; they both said:
We asked him about bridges: are their people liable for anything? He said: No.

key_terms.أَهْلُهَا: its people; those associated with or responsible for the bridges
key_terms.أَيَضْمَنُ: is liable; bears legal responsibility or compensation
key_terms.الْجُسُورِ: bridges; public crossings being asked about in the legal ruling
key_terms.شَيْئًا: anything; any amount or form of liability
key_terms.لَا: no; the Imam’s direct negative ruling

ai.seo_question: Are the people responsible for bridges legally liable for damages according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal question posed to Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام regarding liability connected to bridges. The Imam عليه السلام answers briefly that the people responsible for them are not liable, indicating a concise fiqh ruling on civil responsibility in this case.
